name: Feature request

---

## Problem

Describe the analyst's task and where the current experience gets in the way.

## Desired outcome

Describe the behavior and one concrete example. Mention any accessibility needs.

## Acceptance evidence

Explain how a reviewer can verify the outcome. For UI work, include keyboard,
screen-reader, contrast, responsive-browser and performance expectations. For
content or native rules, identify the required provenance, reviewers and fixtures.

## Alternatives and scope

Explain alternatives considered and any requirements for data access or external
services. Do not include confidential environment details.

## Privacy and compatibility

State whether this changes local-only behavior, network access, telemetry, CLI,
exports, schemas or the future API. New uploads, analytics, credentials or
external services require a separate security and data-flow review.
